researchQuestion: How should a MemoryCore sidecar update, invalidate, retrieve, organize and budget memory under controlled feedback without replacing the base index?

incumbent.name: correction-linked fixed-budget redirection
incumbent.deploymentBoundary: Positive on stale-exposed, forgetting-bearing and recommending Memora slices; not supported as an unconditional full-traffic default.

currentModelCallsExcludingLegacySecondar.note: Primary V1/V2, D1, D4, D14, D15 and D16 calls; byte-identical reused cells are not double-counted.

directions.name: 纠错链固定预算重定向
directions.hypothesis: 检索到旧记忆时沿高置信 predecessor-to-successor 边重定向，可减少过时事实并保持 k=5。
directions.mainEvidence: 50-case conditioned panel: FAMA +0.0809 [0.0517,0.1259]. Broad 200-case panel: FAMA +0.0142 [-0.00005,0.0308]; forgetting-bearing +0.0296 [0.0074,0.0549].
directions.lesson: Mechanism is useful in high-risk lifecycle traffic but is not a universal default.

directions.name: 上下文策略组合
directions.hypothesis: 更高阈值、两跳、额外槽位和历史聚合保护可同时改善召回与遗忘。
directions.mainEvidence: Conditioned panel versus V1: FAMA -0.0043, FAA -0.0408, tokens +37.5%. Broad panel: FAMA +0.0021 [-0.0073,0.0108], tokens +11.1%.
directions.lesson: A proxy-selected joint policy can improve retrieval while degrading answer safety and cost.

directions.name: 过时值屏蔽渲染
directions.mainEvidence: Obsolete context exposure 74% to 8%, but MPA -0.0202 with a negative confidence interval.

directions.name: 查询风险路由
directions.mainEvidence: FAA +0.0283 but MPA -0.0115 and one reader's FAMA direction remained negative.

directions.name: 删除空位回填
directions.mainEvidence: Direct proxy +0.0140 but below the +0.02 gate; tokens +2.89%.

directions.name: 反馈优化的有效状态装箱
directions.mainEvidence: Fresh 50-case answer panel FAMA +0.0116 and tokens -3.27%, but CI [-0.0014,0.0290].
directions.lesson: Near miss; positive point estimates are insufficient for promotion.

directions.name: 目标键控状态投影
directions.mainEvidence: Untouched test state-FAMA +0.0646 but CI [-0.0240,0.1510] with four harmed cases.

directions.name: incumbent 保真组合守卫
directions.mainEvidence: Post-hoc consumed audit state-FAMA +0.0611, 28 improved and zero harmed.

directions.name: 状态变化差分组织
directions.mainEvidence: Development support +0.0813; validation reversed to -0.0667 and tokens +3.50%.

directions.name: 反馈学习的变化效用门
directions.mainEvidence: Untouched test tokens -2.92%, direct support exactly unchanged with zero improved cases.

directions.name: 结果门控的过程记忆
directions.mainEvidence: Development signal favored the outcome-agnostic ablation; validation support -0.1111.

directions.name: 局部验证过程替换
directions.mainEvidence: Tokens -33.55% but one correct StaticText answer body was lost; local feedback added no quality lift.

directions.name: 证据保真压缩
directions.mainEvidence: Untouched 30-question test tokens 2796.8 to 2213.9 (-20.84%); direct support equal on all 12 scored questions.

directions.name: 轨迹一致外部证据扩展
directions.mainEvidence: Development direct support -0.0333 versus Base; five harmed cases.

directions.name: 残差反馈补丁
directions.mainEvidence: 23 direct questions all equal to Base while tokens increased 0.99%.

directions.name: 前提反驳证据
directions.mainEvidence: 2 valid triggers from 33 premise cases; four reader pairs all equal to Base.

directions.name: 类型化反驳与充分性契约
directions.mainEvidence: Three of four consumed design pairs improved, but fresh validation had zero triggers over 23 premise cases.

directions.name: 广覆盖基线与单因素答案消融
directions.mainEvidence: 200 unconsumed answer cases, 13 arms, 1894 reader and 1894 crossed-judge calls. No challenger passed the frozen full-population gate.
directions.lesson: V1 helps forgetting-bearing and recommending traffic but shows an MPA harm signal on remembering questions.

directions.name: 立场感知代理指标
directions.mainEvidence: Kendall tau-b with answer FAMA improved only 0.5290 to 0.5385, below the frozen +0.10 gate.

directions.name: 文本纠错检测与自动构链
directions.mainEvidence: Persona-disjoint test: event precision 0.9789, recall 0.7964, but predecessor-link precision 0.2005, any-correct-link rate 0.4538 and kind accuracy 0.8234.
directions.lesson: Detecting that a correction occurred is much easier than deciding exactly which prior memory it invalidates. V1 remains oracle-management evidence.

finalConclusions: Use V1 only behind a risk/coverage gate until a fresh selective-routing confirmation exists.
Keep D11 as a separately promoted efficiency candidate and require answer-level noninferiority on new data.
Do not promote policies from retrieval proxies alone; D16 and D17 show imperfect proxy-answer alignment.
The largest unresolved technical problem is scoped predecessor linking, especially for repository, branch, commit, environment and task-phase state.
Every adaptive sidecar remains switchable and must return the exact Base call on disablement, damage or timeout.
